approval.owner: The project owner, as recorded in the decision log
approval.decisionEntry: 13 Oct 2026 — Night material B is approved, with brass and engraving still provisional.
approval.scope: The owner chose the top row of the final blind comparison: visible night ground, paper, timber, floor, steel, glass and jacket colours, the shown ordinary and dark stroke treatment, and flat lit lamp/screen colours. Brass and engraving remain provisional separately. The captured blockout does not approve geometry, proportions, lamp or instrument design, kit unit, interface typography, name plates or renderer acceptance.

flatMaterialMapping.paper: Source paper-0 through paper-3 all equal the approved flat paper value; the legacy diagnostic paper alias is excluded.
flatMaterialMapping.screen-light: Source screen-light-0 through screen-light-3 all equal the approved flat lit-screen value.
flatMaterialMapping.lamp-light: Source lamp-light-0 through lamp-light-3 all equal the approved flat diffuser value. These emitted-light faces are not raised body ramps.

ordinary.scope: Ordinary material outlines, including dark room materials and the page ground.

surfaceDark.scope: Paper and lit lamp/screen faces own dark strokes on their own face; they do not spread dark strokes onto dim neighbouring housings.

instrumentContour.scope: Brass and engraved ticks share the complete dark instrument contour, including adjoining edge pixels on the verified mounting face. This shown stroke treatment does not finalize instrument materials or geometry; new mounts still require a contrast check.

provisionalNightInstrument.reason: The owner’s night pick retains the existing provisional brass and engraving status until real instrument geometry is reviewed. The use of the approved dark outline colour for engraving remains provisional.

unshownSupportValues.reason: These source slots reproduce the study but had no visible pixels in the picked camera. New geometry and views require their own checks.

provenance.blindSelection: Top row of work/look/tones/night-007/review-all.png, recorded by the owner as “Top”.
provenance.derivation: Derived from corrected day A without a night reference; all 44 existing source day values and day opacity were retained. Added dormant day light/engraving values are not approved by this night pick.

captureEvidence.approvalScope: Reproduction metadata, not approval of camera scale, geometry or renderer acceptance.
captureEvidence.fontManifestMeaning: Empty wordless-canvas font manifest; no interface glyphs or font bytes are certified.

day.reason: Corrected day A is separately approved within that brief’s recorded scope.
